description: Fork of exp188 (E=96 + big unembedder, but using its 8K-step config). Two architecture changes: (1) qk_input_nap 6 -> 8 (table_dim 64 -> 256, 4x richer per-table; matches exp174's qk_input_nap), (2) out_tph_per_layer removed -> uniform out_tph=2048 (was [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024]; bumps L2-5 from 60% to 119% pair coverage). qk_joint per-layer 6.29M -> 25.17M (+18.88M); out_proj per-layer averages 8.39M -> 12.58M (+4.19M); total LUTs 144.6M -> 282.95M (+138M). Total 302M -> ~440M. n_steps=8000 (sanity check before 48K). Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
